story_text: As a user, I want to retrieve a single task by its ID so that I can view its full details.

positive.title: Retrieve an existing task by valid ID
steps: 1. Create a task and note its ID
2. Send GET request to /tasks/{id} with the noted ID
positive.expected_result: 200 OK · full task object returned with all fields

positive.title: Verify all fields present in single task response
steps: 1. Create a task with all fields filled and note its ID
2. Send GET request to /tasks/{id} with the noted ID
positive.expected_result: Response contains id, title, description, category, priority, status, createdAt

negative.title: Retrieve task with non-existent ID
steps: 1. Send GET request to /tasks/{id} with a non-existent ID

negative.title: Retrieve task with non-numeric ID
steps: 1. Send GET request to /tasks/{id} with a non-numeric ID

negative.title: Retrieve another user's task
steps: 1. Send GET request to /tasks/{id} with another user's task ID

edge.title: Retrieve a task with alot of data in description
steps: 1. Create a task with a very long description and note its ID
2. Send GET request to /tasks/{id} with the noted ID
edge.expected_result: 200 OK · full task object returned with all fields, description truncated if exceeds limit
